entries.name: 巨灵骨髓
entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: square inventory item icon for a dark realistic fantasy RPG, displayed at 70 pixels.
Style/medium: premium hand-painted realistic dark fantasy game item artwork, weathered tangible surfaces, grounded volume, restrained luminous accents, muted metal and bone textures. Strong readable silhouette, not cartoon, not an emoji, not vector art.
Scene/backdrop: uniform near-black neutral background with only very subtle ambient falloff. No scenery.
Composition/framing: a single isolated object centered in a square image, entire silhouette visible, object occupies about 70 percent of the canvas, generous clean margins. Crisp shape and simple major masses that remain recognizable at 70 pixels.
Subject: an ancient titanic bone-marrow relic, a short substantial ivory fossil bone segment with one irregular split exposing a luminous amber-gold marrow core. This is a sacred physical relic of immense ancestral strength, not a medical specimen. A few natural mineral veins, aged ivory shell, warm molten amber heart, solid heavy silhouette.
Lighting/mood: controlled golden core light and soft cool rim light, rich shadows, solemn ancient power.
Constraints: one single artifact only; no hands, no people, no surrounding decorative objects, no UI, no border, no frame, no letters, no writing, no symbols that read as text, no logo, no watermark. Do not create a contact sheet. Square composition.

entries.name: 血脉祭司
entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: square NPC portrait for a dark realistic fantasy RPG, intended to be recognizable at 70 pixels.
Primary request: an independent adult mysterious bloodline priest, chest-up bust, solemn and wise, an unmistakably human face visible. This is a person portrait, not an item icon.
Style/medium: highly finished realistic hand-painted dark fantasy game concept art, muted antique metal textures and layered worn ceremonial cloth, comparable to a grounded Chinese dark fantasy RPG NPC portrait.
Subject: an adult androgynous bloodline ritual priest about forty years old, calm serious expression, dark swept-back hair, modest dark charcoal and deep oxblood ritual robes, a broad restrained bronze ceremonial collar and a small amber stone at the throat. No weapons, no staff, no object held in front of the face. Face and shoulders have a strong simple silhouette.
Scene/backdrop: almost black neutral interior shadow, very faint architectural atmosphere only, no bright background objects.
Composition/framing: square canvas, centered chest-up bust facing viewer with a slight three-quarter turn, full top of head and shoulders within frame, face in upper center, subject occupies around 75 percent of image. Prioritize a clear readable face and collar at small size.
Lighting/mood: soft warm amber face illumination with subtle cool rim light, solemn occult atmosphere without horror or gore.
Constraints: one adult person, no other characters, no item-only composition, no text, no letters, no logo, no border, no UI, no watermark, no excessive jewels or intricate clutter. Do not create a contact sheet.
